text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-development claim in the opening and conclusion","quality":"thesis consistency","description":"The essay maintains a clear position on driverless cars from start to finish instead of drifting or sounding uncertain."},{"evidence":"uses fuel, pollution, and safety as separate points","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay groups its ideas into distinct lines of argument that are easy to follow."},{"evidence":"explains half the fuel means less pollution","quality":"reasoned elaboration","description":"The essay does more than mention evidence by developing a chain of reasoning from the source to the claim."},{"evidence":"adds a counterargument about liability law","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges a limitation and briefly addresses it, which makes the argument feel more balanced."},{"evidence":"concludes with a forward-looking call to accept the future","quality":"conclusion strength","description":"The ending restates the claim and leaves the reader with a clear final takeaway."}]}
